items.question: What is the maximum number of consecutive nights for which a hotel in Dubai charges the Tourism Dirham Fee?
items.gold: The Tourism Dirham Fee in Dubai is charged per room per night for a maximum of 30 consecutive nights.
items.fact: Dubai Tourism Dirham Fee capped at 30 consecutive nights

items.question: How much is the tourism fee per room per night charged by hotels in Ras Al Khaimah, in AED?
items.gold: Hotels in Ras Al Khaimah charge AED 15 tourism fee per room per night.
items.fact: Ras Al Khaimah hotels charge AED 15 tourism fee nightly
